Name: Base board
Notes: Cut 450 x 300 from 18 mm MDF; drill per base template DXF.

Name: Mast
Notes: Cut 550 long, square ends.

Name: Arm
Notes: Cut 450 long; pulley bracket screws at x = 392 / 408 (pilot 2.5).

Name: Diagonal brace
Notes: Cut 249 mm long on the long edge; ends cut at 48 / 42 deg to sit flush on mast and arm.

Name: L-bracket 50 (mast-base)
Notes: Hardware store 50 x 50 x 15 angle bracket; 4 x wood screws 4 x 20.

Name: Corner plate (mast-arm)
Notes: 80 x 90 mending plate, or cut from 2 mm steel; glue joint as well.

Name: Counterweight
Notes: Stack steel plates to 2.0 kg; M5 bolts through the base.

Name: Motor plate
Notes: Cut 200 x 90 from 10 mm MDF; drill per DXF.

Name: Worm gear motor JGY-370 12 V
Notes: JGY-370, 10-30 rpm, rated >= 8 kg.cm, 6 mm D-shaft.

Name: Rope drum
Notes: Print upright; M3 grub screw onto the motor shaft flat; rope through the 2 mm hole and knotted.

Name: Stub shaft 6 mm
Notes: Cut 32 mm of 6 mm silver steel; glue/press into the drum bore from the encoder side.

Name: Flexible coupler 6-6
Notes: 19 x 25 mm 6-6 mm jaw / beam coupler.

Name: Encoder 600 P/R (LPD3806)
Notes: 600 P/R, NPN open-collector A/B, 6 mm shaft.

Name: Encoder bracket
Notes: Bend 90 deg (or print). Check the encoder flange screw spacing before drilling.

Name: Pulley wheel 24 mm (624ZZ)
Notes: V-groove wheel OD 24 with 4 mm bore bearing.

Name: Pulley U-bracket
Notes: Bend from 3 mm aluminium strip or print; 1 wood screw into the arm + glue, or 2 screws with a wider base.

Name: Limit switch (roller micro switch)
Notes: SPDT roller lever micro switch; wire COM + NO to A2/GND.

Name: Limit switch mount
Notes: Print; slot the switch holes 3 mm long to adjust the trip point.

Name: Z-mount top plate
Notes: Rope eye bolt in the centre hole; load cell left end screw at x - 32.

Name: Load cell 5 kg (TAL220 type)
Notes: 80 x 12.7 x 12.7 bar, 1-2 mV/V, arrow pointing down.

Name: Z-mount bottom plate
Notes: S-hook eye in the centre hole; load cell right end screw at x + 32.

Name: Basket 70 x 60 x 70
Notes: Small plastic basket; 4 strings to the hook.

Name: Electronics box
Notes: Bought box; drill the side panel and floor per DXF.

Name: Lid with control panel
Notes: Drill / cut per lid DXF; 16 mm buttons, 22 mm E-stop, 19 mm key switch.

Name: Shield PCB 120 x 90
Notes: KiCad design; Gerbers in hardware/.
